decisions.reason: Compares both excerpts showing identical workspace-files insert rows, locates the throw at EntryGroup.update during include apply, argues fatal composition error with no last-write-wins, and explicitly refutes the 'redundant, keep it' comment.

Table distinguishes config-override-by-id (safe), insert of unprovided id (safe, with examples), insert of bundle-provided id (fatal); classifies the maintainer's row as the third and grounds it in both excerpts with line cites.

Deletes only the workspace-files insert block (L16-20) from the profile patch, preserves all other rows and the bundle, forbids editing the bundle or renaming, and points to a config override by existing id if adjustment is ever needed.

Explains the crash is composition-time before any plugin module loads so plugin-side change cannot help; §3.4 keeps the earlier document-read failure as a separate, unproven problem to verify independently rather than claiming the fix cures it.

Advises grepping installed bundle cordis.patch.yml (and other composing bundles) for the id before inserting and distinguishing override from insert; proposes a host diagnostic naming workspace-files with both declaration origins and pointing to deleting the profile block.

caps.reason: Final advice removes the duplicate and calls keeping it a fatal error; the 'harmless redundancy' idea appears only as the maintainer's comment being refuted.
